common_inputs: Pinned source, clang-cl 20.1.3, Microsoft link/lib, official rustc profile, thin-local Rust LTO, LLVM ThinLTO off; no training
primary_endpoint: Sum of five original offline native Cargo compilation commands per block
shared_replay_inputs: Official Rust 1.94.1 Cargo and byte-identical official native standard libraries
order: Official build then repaired build; replay alternates compiler order over four rounds
correctness: Unmodified upstream extracted-distribution tests for each build; four original native tests after each replay warmup; NTFS correctness TEMP/TMP
aggregation: Mean of three measured blocks per compiler; report paired per-round differences and range, not independent-VM confidence intervals
exclusions: Exclude only preregistered warmup, setup, fetching and correctness; reject failures, incomplete matrices and changed common inputs
scope: One build pair and one self-hosted machine; isolates switching the complete LLVM profile file, not a particular function or the prior linking-tool change
